The HWPX manipulation task was successfully completed with a perfect reward by addressing XML fragmentation and layout cache issues.
The script resolved placeholder fragmentation by aggregating text at the paragraph level before redistribution into <hp:t> tags. It prevented rendering artifacts by identifying modified <hp:p> elements and removing <hp:lineSegArray> tags. Business logic for budget normalization and month span calculation was verified via a double-check step that confirmed no '{{' patterns remained.
